current_delivery_rate_mbps: Current Sage delivery-rate estimate in Mbps.
current_loss_mbps: Current Sage loss estimate, expressed as an equivalent Mbps loss signal.
current_loss_mbps_avg: Rolling average of the current Sage loss signal over the retained shield history.
current_loss_mbps_delta: Difference between the newest and oldest retained values of the current Sage loss signal.
current_loss_mbps_max: Rolling maximum of the current Sage loss signal over the retained shield history.
current_loss_mbps_min: Rolling minimum of the current Sage loss signal over the retained shield history.
current_min_rtt_ratio: Current ratio between min RTT and current RTT; lower values imply stronger inflation.
current_min_rtt_ratio_avg: Rolling average of the current min-RTT ratio over the retained shield history.
current_min_rtt_ratio_delta: Difference between the newest and oldest retained values of the current min-RTT ratio.
current_min_rtt_ratio_max: Rolling maximum of the current min-RTT ratio over the retained shield history.
current_min_rtt_ratio_min: Rolling minimum of the current min-RTT ratio over the retained shield history.
current_rtt_ms: Current Sage RTT estimate in milliseconds.
current_rtt_ms_avg: Rolling average of the current Sage RTT estimate over the retained shield history.
current_rtt_ms_delta: Difference between the newest and oldest retained values of the current Sage RTT estimate.
current_rtt_ms_max: Rolling maximum of the current Sage RTT estimate over the retained shield history.
current_rtt_ms_min: Rolling minimum of the current Sage RTT estimate over the retained shield history.
current_rttvar_ms: Current Sage RTT variation estimate in milliseconds.
delivery_growth_ratio: Ratio of current delivery rate to the previous delivery rate.
loss_to_windowed_rate_ratio: Ratio of current loss signal to the current windowed delivery rate.
max_delivery_growth_ratio: Maximum recent delivery-growth ratio observed by Sage.
max_windowed_delivery_rate_mbps: Maximum recent windowed Sage delivery-rate estimate in Mbps.
previous_action: Most recent Sage control action before the current decision.
previous_action_avg: Rolling average of the previous Sage action over the retained shield history.
previous_action_delta: Difference between the newest and oldest retained values of the previous Sage action.
previous_action_max: Rolling maximum of the previous Sage action over the retained shield history.
previous_action_min: Rolling minimum of the previous Sage action over the retained shield history.
rtt_inflation: Reciprocal of current_min_rtt_ratio, summarizing RTT inflation relative to the minimum RTT.
time_delta_ms: Elapsed time in milliseconds since the previous Sage observation update.
windowed_delivery_rate_mbps: Windowed Sage delivery-rate estimate in Mbps.
windowed_delivery_rate_mbps_avg: Rolling average of the windowed Sage delivery-rate estimate over the retained shield history.
windowed_delivery_rate_mbps_delta: Difference between the newest and oldest retained values of the windowed Sage delivery-rate estimate.
windowed_delivery_rate_mbps_max: Rolling maximum of the windowed Sage delivery-rate estimate over the retained shield history.
windowed_delivery_rate_mbps_min: Rolling minimum of the windowed Sage delivery-rate estimate over the retained shield history.
windowed_vs_max_rate_ratio: Ratio of windowed delivery rate to the recent maximum windowed delivery rate.
